name: comp-585
title: Icon Nav Team Header
blurb: Icon navbar with search, team icons, notifications, user menu.
description: Header with icon nav buttons, search input, icon navigation menu, message/notification buttons, and user menu.
use_when: Collaboration apps or team tools needing quick access to search, messaging, and team features.
avoid_when: Text-first navigation; icon-only nav requires user familiarity.
a11y: Icons have aria-label or sr-only text. Search input labeled. Nav menu keyboard-navigable.
